segments.text: Allow over receipt of products in Business Central. In Business Central, you can receive more products than you've ordered from your vendor or suppliers.
This is necessary because sometimes you actually receive more than you ordered, and you want to put these items on your inventory. To handle this, we have what we call over receipt codes.
Let's have a look. Bring up the tell me search with Alt Q, and we search for over receipt. And select over receipt codes from the list. Here, I have two over receipt codes.
One that allows for 10% over receipt tolerance, and one that allows for 20%. I can set these over receipt codes on my products, and I can set these over receipt codes on my vendors.
The most restrictive setting wins. So, if you have a setting that allows for 10% on the item and 20% over receipt on the vendor, the 10% will have effect if you try to receive that item.
Let's see how they work. Here, I'm on the item card of one of our products, and I want to be able to receive more than I ordered on this specific product. So, I set the over receipt code.
